text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days before tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's the weekend. I'm walking along the 
riverbank when I see Eishin 
Flash training.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Break time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's training fairly intensely. 
It's clear from her strained 
expression that 
she's fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Break time... over.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huff... Next is—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After introducing myself as an academy 
trainer, I point out that she 
obviously 
needs more rest, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I... I'm just fine. The short break times 
are accounted for in my 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's 3 p.m., and my fatigue is at predicted 
levels. I plan to catch my 
breath during the 
thirty-minute break coming up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like her absolute confidence in 
her schedule won't allow her 
to stray from 
it. But I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I have included a certain 
amount of buffer time. For 
example, your 
talking to me has caused a delay of four 
minutes and 
twenty-five seconds.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, it's all right. If I scratch my next 
five-minute break, I'll be back on
 
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's pushing my limits, I am aware. As I have 
an immediate goal to 
accomplish, my 
current schedule is tighter than usual.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And following it perfectly is my top 
priority. If I don't, I...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It's been five minutes and forty-five 
seconds. I can't afford to lose 
any more 
time, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I forgot to say—I appreciate you showing 
concern for me. I'll be going 
now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is determined to win her race, 
no question. However, it's 
apparent she's 
so determined that it's stressing her out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tryouts are important, sure, but they're 
held throughout the year. 
Could there be 
some reason why she has to debut now?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Why, hello there. ☆ Have time for a quick 
chat?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Flash is my roommate, you see. So I know 
all about just how hard she's 
been training.
choice_data_list: Could that be the reason too?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Of course! But keep all this off the 
record, mkay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So for the upcoming tryouts, her parents 
are apparently coming all 
the way from 
Germany to watch!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Her family runs, like, a popular cake shop, 
right? So they're taking 
time out of their 
super busy schedule to visit—that's why 
Flash is 
trying so hard.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well, that certainly answers why she's 
going all out for this race. But 
even so, 
being so strict about her schedule isn't the 
only way to 
improve.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: At any rate, that's just about all I can say.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, my Falco senses were just telling me 
I should. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the two of you talking, I got 
this feeling—maybe you'd be 
able to 
understand how amazing she is. ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You're curious about Flash, aren't you? 
Make sure you keep your eyes 
on her. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's now the day before tryouts, and I'm 
mulling over what exactly 
Smart Falcon 
meant as I walk across campus.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Toi, toi, toi...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah... We met the other day.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's this German good luck charm my 
parents taught me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
You tap your desk three times while 
chanting, "Toi, toi, toi." The 
noise wards 
off evil and brings good luck, supposedly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I know it probably doesn't actually do 
anything, but I want to make 
sure 
everything goes according to plan 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, not exactly. It's just... my busy parents 
have made time to come 
watch my race 
tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have to perform my job properly and 
achieve perfect results—it's my 
duty, as 
their daughter.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If something goes awry, and my results 
are... lacking, they won't have 
much to be 
proud of.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't pretend to know much about her, 
much less her parents, but 
just seeing her 
run is enough to know how much effort 
she's put into 
this.
choice_data_list: You should be proud of your efforts.
Your efforts are something to be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That... No, that's wrong. It makes light of 
discipline and 
reason—nothing but empty 
flattery.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've just noticed that something's off with 
her. She's short of breath, 
and rather 
pale...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My schedule may have pushed me a little 
past my limits, but I did all I 
needed to 
improve.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Slight discomfort like this is within my 
margin of error. Besides, today 
is a rest 
day. I'll be fully recovered by tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's no power in her voice, much less 
conviction. I can't imagine 
her bouncing 
back so soon.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: No, absolutely not!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have no plans to take tomorrow off. I've 
worked hard to win my 
race—to achieve 
the perfect results!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can't deviate from my schedule now—I do 
things as planned until 
they're finished. Or 
else... or... else...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Everything will be... thrown off...
